captions.detailed: A light-grey food processor consisting of a wide rectangular base with rounded corners and a cylindrical, semi-transparent bowl. The bowl features a vertical handle and fits onto the base with a revolute bayonet joint. On top of the bowl, a flat disc lid is attached via a revolute hinge, and it includes a tall, rectangular feeding chute. Inside the bowl, a dual-sided metal blade is mounted on a central pin and is capable of continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a food processor with a rounded rectangular base, a side-mounted control knob, and a semi-transparent cylindrical bowl. The bowl should attach via a revolute bayonet joint, feature an edge-hinged lid with a rectangular chute, and contain an inner dual-sided blade designed for continuous rotation.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a rounded Box primitive, adding a smaller raised tier and a Cylinder for the control knob. Model the bowl as a hollow Cylinder with a thin wall, attaching a Box-based handle. Create the lid as a flat Cylinder with a rectangular Box chute, and define a revolute joint near its edge. Model the blade assembly with a central shaft and flat rectangular extrusions for the blades, setting a continuous joint along the vertical Z-axis.
